end.parentNote: Shaurya practised position words using objects, containers, and a reference point. They explained that a lid was outside and that a fish is inside water, correcting the earlier mix-up during the lesson. At home, ask them to describe where three toys are using “inside/outside,” “near/far,” and “on/under.”
